repair.title: One Treaty Also Cooled The Future
repair.summary: UNEP's Ozone Secretariat says cuts in ozone-depleting substances are estimated to avoid about 0.5 to 1 degrees Celsius of warming by mid-century.
repair.why_it_matters: A treaty built for one environmental crisis also reduced a major climate risk.
repair.caveat: The avoided-warming estimate depends on comparison scenarios and continued compliance.
